title: Sources: Databricks is in early talks to raise several billion dollars at a ~$225B valuation, after closing a $5B round at a $190B valuation in August (Wall Street Journal)
summary: Wall Street Journal: Sources: Databricks is in early talks to raise several billion dollars at a ~$225B valuation, after closing a $5B round at a $190B valuation in August — The new financing would represent a nearly 20% increase from its August valuation — Databricks is in early talks to raise several billion dollars …
contentText:
Wall Street Journal :

Sources: Databricks is in early talks to raise several billion dollars at a ~$225B valuation, after closing a $5B round at a $190B valuation in August   —  The new financing would represent a nearly 20% increase from its August valuation  —  Databricks is in early talks to raise several billion dollars …
